$comment: E14 FR-14.1 — the ONE list of user-facing namespaces for te / ta: the buying path, plus every other buyer, provider and public screen (buyer home, provider Today / listings / earnings, profile and signup, the assistant, group requests, Why AMClub and help). The `legal` namespace (the Terms / Privacy / Refund / Provider Addendum texts) is deliberately NOT listed: its machine drafts stay unrendered until counsel and a native reviewer approve them, so te / ta readers see the English documents. Internal admin namespaces (admin, admin_*, trust_admin, the /admin/dev/ui gallery dev_ui) stay English and are not listed. `pnpm --filter @amclub/web i18n:coverage` fails when any key in these namespaces is missing in a locale below (live file or reviewed-pending draft); `--strict` counts drafts as missing (the launch gate). The drafts overlay (EXP_V3_LOCALES) reads the same list. Notification templates are the `notify` namespace (`lib/i18n/notify.ts`).
